title: MAPLE FONDANT ACORNS
instructions: 2 or more squares of Baker's Chocolate,
About 1/4 a cup of fine-chopped almonds, browned in the oven.

Make fondant of the syrup,  granulated sugar and cold water, following the directions given for fondant made of granulated sugar (cream of tartar or other acid is not required in maple fondant).
